The structure is described in the orthorhombic space group Imma (space-group number 74, Hall symbol "-I 2b 2") using a body-centered cell with lattice parameters a = 6.03 Å, b = 6.13 Å, c = 8.45 Å and all interaxial angles fixed at 90°. The supplied input cell is identical to the standard setting: the fractional coordinates in the two frames are related by q_standard = P q_input + s, where P is the 3×3 identity matrix with diagonal entries 1.0 and off-diagonal entries 0.0, and the origin shift s is (0, 0, 0), so no reorientation or translation is required to recover the original input geometry. The input composition comprises 32 atoms per cell, namely 8 lithium, 4 vanadium, 4 nickel, and 16 oxygen atoms, consistent with the multiplicities of the six independent crystallographic orbits described below. All positional values are quoted as fractional coordinates rounded to three decimal places.

The four nickel atoms occupy the Wyckoff site 4a at the fixed position (0, 0, 0), placing Ni at the cell origin and at the symmetry-equivalent points generated by the Imma centering and mirror operations. Vanadium occupies the 4c site with representative coordinate (1/4, 1/4, 1/4), giving four V atoms per cell arranged on the quarter-height positions along all three axes. Lithium is distributed over two distinct fourfold sites: one set of four Li atoms resides on the 4b site at (0, 0, 1/2), while the second set occupies the 4d site at (1/4, 1/4, 3/4), so that the eight Li atoms split evenly between a site at the midplane z = 1/2 on the cell edges and a site displaced to the three-quarter height in the interior of the cell.

The sixteen oxygen atoms divide into two eightfold orbits. The first, on Wyckoff site 8i, has the coordinate relation (x, 1/4, z) with independent parameters x = 0.237 and z = 0.995, so its representative atom sits at (0.237, 0.250, 0.995); the y coordinate is pinned to 1/4 while x and z adopt these refined values, placing these oxygens close to the top face of the cell but slightly displaced inward along x. The second oxygen orbit, on site 8h, follows the relation (0, y, z) with y = 0.027 and z = 0.760, giving a representative position of (0.000, 0.027, 0.760); here the x coordinate is fixed at zero, with the atom lying just off the b-axis origin plane at a height of 0.76 along c. Together with the body-centering translation (1/2, 1/2, 1/2) and the mirror and twofold operations of Imma, these six orbits generate the full 32-atom arrangement: Ni at the corners and body center, V and the two Li sublattices on their respective fixed fourfold positions, and the two oxygen sets each repeated eightfold throughout the orthorhombic cell.
